component.name: Amphi Notes
component.summary: Cross-platform note-taking app that enables users to sync their data with a self-hosted server

description.p: Amphi Notes is a free and open-source, cross-platform note-taking app.

You can insert images and videos into your notes, and format your text. Organize your notes using folders, just like a traditional file system. Once you've written your notes or stories, you can sync them across devices via a self-hosted server.
If you already use Amphi Music, Amphi Photos and Amphi Cloud, your music library, photos, and files can also be synced through the same server.
To set up your own server, visit: https://amphi.site
